Indian Professionals Return to India to Build Startups

Two Indian professionals, one a couple and another a Google techie, have returned to India after spending significant time in the US. The couple plans to build startups in Bengaluru, while the Google techie returned to the US after a decade in India. The decision for the couple was influenced by a family wedding visit.
